note: Rustic state forest campground in a cedar forest on the shore of Lake Huron's Thunder Bay, 1 mi east of Ossineke via US-23 S and Ossineke Road; campground host all season. About half the sites have direct access to a sandy beach; day-use area with picnic tables and grills and a boardwalk out to the lake. Carry-in paddling access from the day-use area or beach sites; Devils River boat launch under a mile north. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20 (confirmed), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump potable water, first-come only, 15-day max, 42 sites (all confirmed, derived -> manual). Sites are for 'tent, small trailer and large trailer use'; no length posted. Season 'open all year' (roads not plowed) already manual, left. Not equestrian; not an ORV trail camp (table: ORV operation between SFCG and trails 'no'; Devils Lake ORV trail 5 mi NW). Access via US-23 and Ossineke Road, no road warning. Note trimmed of field restatements.
